items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: There was another Spike out there that played violin, Spike Hamilton. He's George Hamilton's father.

ctx.x: Anyway you said Spike had been with Goldkette.

No, Joe had been with the Goldkette band. Way back. We're talking about now way back before I got there. So Spike, I guess, maybe could have known him. There was another Spike out there that played violin, Spike Hamilton. He's George Hamilton's father.
I didn't know that, but I knew when
